notes: Headline, a short extract of at most 200 characters, and a link back to the original. We do not reproduce full text. A rolling window: items stay for up to 120 days rather than vanishing when a source drops them, because arXiv announces nothing at weekends and government feeds are short. Categories are assigned by keyword rule and each item carries the terms that matched, so the classification can be checked rather than trusted. Departmental communications are political statements about policy, not neutral descriptions of it, and preprints are not peer reviewed.
